name: DYNO MUTT
description:
This is not your regular dog. This is Dynomutt. The green robot wonder dog who never knows when to quit.

He's clumsy, he's loud, he's got a gadget for everything that goes wrong at the exact wrong time, but somehow he always saves the day. That's his essence. Pure loyal chaos. Green armor, green cape flying, eyes glowing like he's about to malfunction again — because he is.

Essence of Dynomutt is for the ones who are built different. Literally built. Metal, wires, bolts, but with a heart that beats louder than any real dog. He'll stretch his neck 20 feet, he'll pull a toaster out of his chest, he'll set off every alarm, and he'll still stand in front of you when trouble comes.

This coin captures that moment he bursts through. Not sneaking in, not quietly — CRASHING through a glittering cracked coin, shards of green diamonds flying everywhere, cape flapping, paws out like he's about to save you and knock over a building doing it.

Dynomutt energy is not perfect. It's powerful, it's goofy, it's unstoppable, and it's 100% loyal to the end.

That's the essence. Green. Glowing. And always ready to leap.
